overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the February 23 notice's license-transfer and pledge topic was sufficiently specific, despite the misnamed business and omitted pledge recipient.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the February 23 licensing meeting notice lacked specificity: it misnamed the business and did not name the bank receiving the pledges.
allegations.key_passage: we are satisfied that the topic as listed was sufficient to reasonably advise the public of the issue to be discussed at the meeting.
